verdict.rationale: Granola has some first-party operations that act on many notes at once. CSV export pulls all historical notes in one action, Chat can run against all meetings or a folder, and a transcript auto-deletion policy applies across the board. Nothing documents true bulk actions such as multi-select edit, move, tag, delete or share; the API and MCP are building blocks, not bulk features. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/move/delete/share of multiple notes, bulk operations via API or agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
